name: Kâtip Çelebi

checks.lead: Mustafa ibn Abdullah, known with the pen name Kâtip Çelebi (كاتب جلبي) or Ḥājjī Khalīfa (حاجي خليفة)  (1017 AH/1609 CE – 1068 AH/1657 CE) was a Turkish polymath and author of the 17th-century Ottoman Empire. He compiled a vast universal bibliographic encyclopaedia of books and sciences, the Kaşf az-Zunūn, and wrote many treatises and essays. “A deliberate and impartial historian… of extensive learning”, Franz Babinger hailed him "the greatest encyclopaedist among the Ottomans."
